title: Enhanced gastric cancer classification and quantification interpretable framework using digital histopathology images.
summary: A learned image framework classifies gastric-cancer histopathology images and quantifies regions of interest, a specific retrospective diagnostic-validation result. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
ai_technology: Primary Results report normal/abnormal classification of H&E images and image-region analysis with comparator performance.
organization: Faculty of Information Technology & Computer Science, University of Central Punjab, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan

evidence.unknown: Retrospective image classification does not establish clinical deployment; interpretation is restricted to the tested dataset.
